newsitem.title: USA: BAA completes Duty Free tender offer.
newsitem.headline: BAA completes Duty Free tender offer.

text.p: BAA Plc said it had completed a cash tender offer for the common shares of Duty Free International Inc at $24 per share in cash.

It said that as of midnight EDT, August 5, a total of 27,568,581 common shares of Duty Free were validly tendered, including 881,813 shares with notice of guaranteed delivery, and accepted for payment.
The shares represent 99 percent of Duty Free's total outstanding common stock, BAA said.
The merger between its indirect, wholly-owned subsidiary through which the tender offer was made, is expected to be consummated as promptly as practicable, BAA said.
